answer: Vault artifact filing blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent posts 70 credits, files one artifact in the vault at dawn. A plume stamp binds each record to one key and one epoch. Filings are public; duplicates, reused stamps, double filing burn the bond. Filing runs 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, lock 70,000, against the 40,000 pool. Rented artifacts fail: a borrowed stamp keeps its key. An honest agent files once, pays 38, keeps its bond.
